about_the_game:
Where science ends, there's metaphysics. In the world of 《Guardians of Dao》, don't forget to acquire powerful skills along your adventure. Join forces with your companions to fight off technologically advanced aliens. Be wary of enemies lurking in the shadows. When faced with desperate situations, pray to the gods for help and assistance.

Card Combos

Use the random cards that appear in your hand wisely, and unleash the full potential of your companions with your deck. Should you charge forward and carve a path through the underworld, or defend and seize the opportunity to strike back? While overcoming obstacles, don't forget to secretly learn new skills.

Heroes Gathering

Whether you're new to the martial arts world or a seasoned veteran, you'll always need allies to overcome challenges. Even retreating is a wise strategy. Spark unique sparks with allies on your journey. Find your travel companions and work together to overcome all obstacles.

Gameplay Tutorial

During battle, use W, A, S, and D to control the protagonist's movement. The spacebar controls the tempo of the battle. Once the corresponding skill card's energy is accumulated, you can cast the card's skill.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E4500 (2 * 2200) or equivalent, AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 3600+ (2 * 1910) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 7300 GT (512 MB), Radeon X1300 Pro (256 MB)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E6750 (2 * 2660) or equivalent, AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 5000+ (2 * 2600) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 8600 GT (512 MB), Radeon HD 4650 (1024 MB)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: "Guardians of Dao" is a 2D roguelike card battle martial arts game. You'll lead your companions in a battle against high-tech aliens. The gods will protect you, but your survival depends entirely on your own abilities.
